scopes.name: app-engine:functions:run

scopes.comment: DQL smartscapeNodes queries for new connection detection (AWS_ACCOUNT, AZURE_MICROSOFT_RESOURCES_SUBSCRIPTIONS, GCP_CLOUDRESOURCEMANAGER_GOOGLEAPIS_COM_PROJECT)

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: DQL metric.series queries for connection classification

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: DQL dt.entity.* queries for classic connection detection

scopes.name: settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: Settings V2 API — new cloud connection detection (hyperscaler-authentication)

scopes.name: document:documents:read
scopes.comment: List and read new dashboards via Document Service API (Story 002)

scopes.name: document:documents:admin
scopes.comment: Scan dashboards owned by other users — confirmed available without special approval (Story 002)

scopes.name: environment-api:slo:read
scopes.comment: Classic SLO list via GET /classic/environment-api/v2/slo — required for Sub-scan A in Story 005
